# TALDEA

> Private, encrypted, and ephemeral groups. All moments vanish. Chapters expire. No feeds, no likes, zero footprint.

TALDEA is a social app for short-lived photo groups. People join from links, share what is happening for a day, and the group disappears.

- Home: https://taldea.app/
- About: https://taldea.app/about/
